ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels and 35% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black central region. High-intensity white contiguous blocks are located at the distal tips of both lobes. These regions are connected to complex, web-like high-contrast linear networks extending inward toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression; the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence but indicates a narrow pixel-angle of approximately 40-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile along the entire boundary with higher-frequency peaks and valleys on the distal half of both lobes compared to the regions near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips, showing a pronounced recurved geometric profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel clusters on the outermost margins of the distal tips, localized within the white pigmentation zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense manifestation of parallel and intersecting linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) that overlay the natural pigmentation, particularly prominent on the trailing half of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring covering more than 50% of the pigmented surface area, showing high-contrast linear patterns against the dark fluke body.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, distinct yellow-orange focal spot located within the high-intensity white patch on the upper-mid section of the left lobe.
